title: Valid Palindrome
statement: Return true when `s`, considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring case, reads the same forward and backward.
hints: Filter to lowercase alphanumeric characters, then compare with the reverse.
Two pointers avoid the extra string: skip non-alphanumeric characters from both ends.
Compare casefolded characters and stop at the first mismatch.
editorial: A palindrome here is defined on the cleaned character sequence, not on the raw string. Move the left pointer forward and the right pointer backward while they point at non-alphanumeric characters. Compare the two characters in lowercase. A mismatch returns false. Meeting in the middle returns true.

examples.input: s = 'A man, a plan, a canal: Panama'

examples.explanation: After cleaning, the string is not a palindrome.

args.s: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
